hints.title: Rounding Rule
hints.text: The purchase amount rounds to the nearest multiple of 10, with ties rounded upward.

hints.title: Integer Arithmetic
hints.text: Adding five before dividing by ten integer-wise achieves half-up rounding to multiples of ten.

hints.title: Balance Deduction
hints.text: Subtract the rounded multiple of ten from the initial 100 dollar balance.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through multiples of ten is unnecessary when closed arithmetic applies directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly implement tie-breaking rounding to nearest multiple of ten.
